name: FerroBRIDGEAddressTypeToHl70190
title: FerroBRIDGE supplement: address-type to HL7 table 0190
description: Adds the FHIR-to-v2 direction of ConceptMap/table-hl70190-to-address-type of hl7.fhir.uv.v2mappings 1.0.0, which maps v2 to FHIR only. Reversed, that map gives postal two sources (M and SH); this map names M (Mailing) for postal, since SH (Shipping) is a delivery address for goods. physical and both have no source in that map and none here. Used by the PID inverse of FerroBRIDGE #1716.
